pages.text: When a pulse ends, players within 16 blocks see its returns through the ground for $(bold)30 seconds$().$(br2)Labels give where to dig from you, e.g. ~ Galena · 24 down · 15 m NE.

pages.title: Shapes
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Corner brackets$(): estimated ore area, in the ore's color$(li)$(bold)Solid box$(): pinned vein$(li)$(bold)White$(): metal$(li)$(bold)Cyan$(): ORSA site$(li)$(bold)Faint blue$(): cave

pages.title: Pinning
pages.text: A $(bold)~$() means an estimate. Pulse again from at least $(bold)8 blocks$() away within 10 minutes and shared veins become exact boxes.

pages.title: What's Skipped
pages.text: Ore you can already see, small common veins and anything behind water.$(br2)The screen lists finds by ore, most valuable first.

pages.title: Survey Sheet
pages.text: Print the last pulse to carry it while you dig.

pages.title: Using a Sheet
pages.text: Hold it near the pulse to see its returns. Each copy costs 1 paper and 1 coal or charcoal.$(br2)It never updates, and the ink fades after one day.
